data.name: Blanka
data.gender_notes: Blanka is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Slavic word 'belok' meaning 'white'. The name Blanka signifies purity, fairness, and cleanliness. In Christian context, it could be associated with the blameless and sinless nature of Jesus. The name Blanka carries the meaning “White, pure, fair” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Blanka usually hope their child will grow to embody white, pure, fair and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of innocence and purity

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Blanka total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
